retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the presidential election of 13 January 1991, at which Mário Soares was re-elected in the first round with about seventy per cent. The atlas holds his election of 1986 and the office's part in the revision of 1982; a re-election that changed neither the holder nor the powers has nothing here to attach to in either direction.
